# FORMLORE: Scary Masterpieces collection notes

> FORMLORE is a small studio that makes printable calendars, gallery prints and journals from public-domain old-master art. This site holds original collection notes on thirty-six works about witches, death, demons, ghosts and yōkai, each credited to its museum (Cleveland Museum of Art, the Met, National Gallery of Art) with a link to the museum's own page. Artworks are public domain; no AI generation or alteration of the artworks.

Notes are original FORMLORE writing and may be quoted briefly with attribution and a link. Artwork details (artist, date, medium, museum) come from the museums' catalogue records.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/): introduction to the collection
- [All 36 works](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/works/): every work with its note
- [About FORMLORE](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/about/): who makes this, sources, FAQ
- [Full text of every note](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/llms-full.txt): all 36 notes in one plain-text file

## Themes
- [Witches](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/witches/): Witches, sabbaths and cauldrons in old-master art (12 works)
- [Death](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/death/): Skeletons, dances of death and memento mori in old-master art (13 works)
- [Demons & Temptations](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/demons-temptations/): Saint Anthony, Bosch's heirs and Satan in old-master art (6 works)
- [Ghosts & Yōkai](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/ghosts-yokai/): Japanese ghosts, demons and yōkai in woodblock prints and scrolls (4 works)
- [The Crossing](https://seeeyi.github.io/formlore-site/the-crossing/): Böcklin's Island of the Dead (1 works)
